correctness.rationale: The two-row binary linear rule on C_n□K2 is conjugate over F2[z]/(z^n+1) to J=[[d,1],[0,d]], d=(z²+z+1)/z. Since P=z²+z+1 has primitive third roots, it divides z^n+1 iff 3|n, with exact multiplicity k=2^v2(n). Chinese-remainder decomposition gives an invertible 2n−4k dimensional complement and nilpotent primary module of dimension 4k; J has nilpotent index 2 for k=1 and exactly k for k even>=2. Solving J^t(u,s)=0 gives binary kernel dimension 2min(t,2) for k=1 or 4min(t,k) otherwise. Counting kernel fibers gives the stated recurrent, entry-time, basin and maximal-time fractions. For m even J^m+I has diagonal factor d^m+1; for m odd the diagonal and d^(m−1) generate the unit ideal, so Smith factors are (1,(d^m+1)^2). Polynomial gcd kernel dimensions with z^n+1 yield |Fix(F^m)| and Möbius inversion yields primitive cycles.
